conformance.rationale: Feature-level v153 suite covers the removal/survivor contract this explainer teaches.

telemetry_health.rationale: Shared demo-telemetry shell active; builder output and validity verdicts are text.

summary: v153 refile of chips-explainer. The 'why removed' step was re-grounded in the ChromeStatus rationale (3PC kept — July 2024/April 2025 — with the privacy criticism as secondary), the Firefox 132+ CHIPS claim was corrected to partition-by-default framing, and the builder toggles gained aria-pressed plus a live-region output. Verified via the responsive harness and a CDP sweep of all tabs and toggle combinations with zero console errors.
